User.title: User
User.description: Telegram user profile and subscription metadata stored by the Astralio Python backend.

telegram_id.description: Unique numeric Telegram user identifier (also used as document ID).

language_code.description: Optional IETF language tag reported by Telegram client.

interface_language.description: Selected Astralio bot interface language code.

created_at.description: UTC timestamp when the user document was first created.

updated_at.description: UTC timestamp of the last profile update.

last_activity.description: UTC timestamp of the user's most recent interaction.

onboarding_completed.description: Whether the user has completed initial /start onboarding.

subscription.description: User subscription plan, status, and expiration metadata.

birth_data.description: Optional natal chart birth data populated in Stage 2+.

/users/{telegramId}.description: Astralio Telegram user profiles keyed by stringified Telegram user ID. Accessed exclusively server-side via Firebase Admin SDK.
